question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Raining cats and dogs
solution:
The correct answer is "**Raining heavily**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**rain very hard**."
 
• We use the idiom "**raining cats and dogs**" to describe a situation where the rain is pouring down heavily.
 
 
• **Example**: Mr. Romero explained that he got late for the meeting as it was raining cats and dogs.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] Hinglish__** 

 
• The meaning of the given idiom is " बहुत कठिन वर्षा".
